objective: By the end of the lesson, learners will be better able to use coordinating conjunctions (and, but, or, so) to write compound sentences in the context of describing a friend.
materials:
- Coursebook: First Steps in Academic Writing, pp 54-59
- Grammar accuracy feedback: 31-05-26-M2-4A-combined.pdf

stages.stage_aim: To activate learners' awareness of their own writing accuracy and build motivation for the grammar focus
stages.procedure: - Distribute grammar accuracy feedback from PDF 1. Ss review individual errors silently (3 min). Praise improvements: class accuracy went up. Then: 'Your first CA is coming — a paragraph introducing a friend and their interests. But first, we need to learn how to write compound sentences properly.' Write goal on board.

stages.stage_aim: To diagnose baseline ability to recognize and form compound sentences
stages.procedure: - Display 6 pairs of simple sentences on screen. Ss join each pair into one compound sentence using and/but/or/so. No instruction given — discovery task. Individual work (5 min). Pair check (2 min). Teacher circulates, notes errors.

stages.stage: Teach — Coordinators: and, but, or, so
stages.stage_aim: To clarify the meaning and function of the four coordinating conjunctions in compound sentences
stages.procedure: - Display Practice 7 formula table: SV V vs SV, and SV. Elicit: 'What makes a sentence compound?' (two subjects, two verb groups, comma + coordinator). Walk through each coordinator's meaning using textbook examples (pp. 56-57). Highlight comma rule: comma BEFORE coordinator.

stages.stage_aim: To give structured practice distinguishing simple from compound sentences
stages.procedure: - Ss complete Practice 8A (items 1-10) + 8B (Teenagers, items 1-9). Underline S/V, circle coordinator, write formula, add commas. Individual (8 min). Pair check (4 min). Display answers. Address tricky items: 9 (compound subject), 10 (imperative).

stages.stage_aim: To give extended practice choosing coordinators and writing own compound sentences
stages.procedure: - Practice 9 (13 coordinator blanks): rapid oral check with screen answers (2 min). Practice 10A (9 sentence pairs to join): individual writing focused on comma + coordinator choice (6 min). Pair compare + display model answers (4 min).

stages.stage_aim: To consolidate key learning and connect to the upcoming CA writing task
stages.procedure: - Quick review: 'How do you make a compound sentence?' (SV, coordinator SV). 'What does but signal?' (contrast). 'Where does the comma go?' (before coordinator). Connect to CA: 'In your paragraph about your friend, use compound sentences.' Preview: 'Next time — fixing broken sentences.'
